resources.title: Tom Looman's Action Roguelike
resources.author: Tom Looman
resources.look: Start with the interaction interface and the inventory component, then the Gameplay Ability attribute set. The course notes in the repo explain why the ability system owns damage.

resources.title: Lyra sample game
resources.author: Epic Games
resources.look: Look at how Experience definitions pick the pawn and the inventory, and how Gameplay Abilities fire weapons. It is a large sample. Read one feature, not the whole game.

resources.title: Content Examples
resources.author: Epic Games
resources.look: Open the level that matches the system you are building. The Blueprint samples show a trace, a timeline, and an AI move without a full game around them.

resources.title: GASDocumentation
resources.author: tranek
resources.look: Read the concepts page before you copy an ability. It names attributes, effects, and the prediction window this app's GAS system is aiming at.

resources.title: Saving and loading your game
resources.author: Epic Games
resources.look: The SaveGame class and the async save calls. Put persistent fields there, not in a widget.

resources.title: Behavior trees
resources.author: Epic Games
resources.look: The quick start shows a blackboard and a tree. Use that when the AI system in this app is a pawn that needs to choose an action.
